title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: Fast mode for Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on Claude in Microsoft Foundry for deployments hosted on Azure.

added_lines: Fast mode for Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on Claude in Microsoft Foundry for deployments hosted on Azure.

Fast mode is out of research preview for Claude Opus 5.5, and you no longer need to request access. Requests to Claude Opus 5.5 no longer require the fast-mode-2026-02-01 beta header, and requests that still send it keep working. Claude Opus 5.5 now has a default fast mode rate limit in every usage tier. Fast mode for Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 4.8 remains in research preview. Keep sending the beta header with fast mode requests to those models.

The Compliance API now returns the text each organization member saved as Instructions for Claude in claude.ai and as Global instructions in Cowork, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations. Call GET /v1/compliance/organizations/{org_uuid}/user_preferences with your existing Compliance Access Key and the read:compliance_user_data scope. See List user preferences.
